title: Remote Jobs Scraper – 5 Boards, Deduped Feed
description: Remote job postings from five public boards (Remotive, Remote OK, Jobicy, Arbeitnow, Working Nomads) in one normalized, newest-first schema, de-duplicated so the same job is never billed twice. Filter by keyword, company, location, salary and date; every row links to the original posting.
seoTitle: Remote Jobs Scraper: 5 Boards, De-duplicated JSON Feed
seoDescription: Scrape remote job postings from Remotive, Remote OK, Jobicy, Arbeitnow and Working Nomads into one JSON schema. Cross-board de-duplication, strict date filters, no start fee.

job.eventDescription: One unique, de-duplicated remote job posting returned to the dataset.
